Bengaluru Delivery Agent Assaulted, Abused in Hindi

A delivery agent in Bengaluru was assaulted and allegedly abused in Hindi by an unidentified group while on a late-night delivery. The incident, which occurred on the road, was captured on camera. Police have registered a case and are investigating the assault. The victim reportedly stated he was beaten with sticks.
